department: Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering
introduction: An awareness workshop was conducted to introduce students to the applications, opportunities, and responsible use of Artificial Intelligence.
objectives: Introduce students to the fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence.
Explain practical applications of AI in engineering.
Encourage students to explore AI-based technologies.
outcomes: Students gained an understanding of basic AI concepts.
Participants learned about practical AI applications.
Students were encouraged to explore further learning opportunities.
conclusion: The workshop provided students with useful insights into Artificial Intelligence and its relevance to engineering education.
